title: CSV Cherrypicking Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs cherrypicking from source to target plates as specified in an input CSV file. The protocol parses the CSV for slots to load the source and target plates. Only non-zero volume transfers are carried out for efficiency, and the user is prompted to refill tipracks if necessary. **This protocol is an update of this [APIv1 protocol](https://protocol-delivery.protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/1617).** --- You will need: * [P10 Single-channel electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette) * [P50 Single-channel electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette?variant=5984549077021) * [P300 Single-channel electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette?variant=5984549109789) * [10µl Pipette tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) * [300µl Pipette tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-300ul-tips) * [Biorad Hard-Shell 96-Well PCR Plates # HSP9601](http://www.bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601) * [Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack Set](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/racks-and-adapters/products/tube-rack-set-1)
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: P10, P50, and P300 single‑channel electronic pipettes; 10 µL and 300 µL pipette tip racks; Biorad Hard‑Shell 96‑Well PCR Plates (catalog HSP9601); and an Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack set.

steps.title: Prepare CSV and set parameters
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that lists source plate slots, target plate slots, wells, and transfer volumes. In the protocol generator, upload the CSV and specify the source and destination plate types and the pipette combination to use.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: After setting the parameters, download the resulting Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to Opentrons App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, create a new protocol run, and upload the downloaded Python protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map: load source plates, target plates, the 10 µL and 300 µL tip racks, and the 4‑in‑1 tube rack in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, perform calibration of each piece of labware, each tip rack, and each pipette (P10, P50, P300) following the on‑screen instructions and the support article for calibration tips.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the Opentrons App to begin execution of the protocol.

steps.title: Execute plate transfers
steps.instruction: The robot will perform a transfer for every non‑zero volume entry in the CSV, using a fresh tip for each transfer. The user will be prompted to replace tip racks when they are depleted. Transfers of 0 µL are automatically skipped for efficiency.
